name: 86 Chaos 17.0.34
label: 86 Chaos 17.0.34
releaseTitle: System Administrator Subpage Unification and PWA Back Navigation
notes: Restyles every System Administrator subpage with the same Concept 1 charcoal cards, bronze accents, headers, spacing, inputs, buttons, and mobile treatment as the seven-card home.
Tapping System Administrator in the drawer always resets the internal admin view to the main seven-card page, even when already inside an admin subpage.
On the installed PWA, the first Back press returns to the previous in-app page; pressing Back again within two seconds exits through the normal Android/PWA history edge.
title: 86 Chaos 17.0.34
summary: Unifies every System Administrator subpage with Concept 1 styling and repairs drawer/back navigation.
description: Applies the approved charcoal/bronze Concept 1 visual system across every System Administrator internal page, makes the drawer System Administrator button always return to the seven-card home, and adds one-level previous-page plus double-back-to-exit behavior for the installed PWA.
